discovery_real.name: File content inspection
discovery_real.description: Inspect an uploaded file in memory using CyberScan's existing bounded static analyzer.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are decoded in memory and are not written to disk by this adapter.

discovery_all_categories.name: Backup Configuration Auditor
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits backup policies (generic JSON/YAML or AWS Backup plans/vaults) for 3-2-1 compliance, encryption, immutability, retention, frequency, failing jobs, untested restores and embedded credentials.

privacy.data_handling: Backup configuration is analysed in memory; secrets in it are masked.

discovery_all_categories.name: CI/CD Configuration Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and Jenkinsfiles for pwn-request triggers, script injection, unpinned actions, over-broad token permissions, leaked secrets, self-hosted runner exposure and unsafe shell steps.

privacy.data_handling: Pipeline files are parsed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Cloud Asset Exposure Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Maps internet exposure across a cloud asset inventory (public IPs, load balancers, open admin/database ports, plain HTTP, missing owners) and finds dangling DNS records pointing at cloud hostnames no longer owned.

privacy.data_handling: The inventory is analysed in memory; nothing is resolved or contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Cloud Configuration Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits exported AWS, Azure and GCP configuration JSON (security groups/NSGs/firewall rules, instances, databases, volumes, CloudTrail, storage accounts, Cloud SQL) for exposure, missing encryption and logging gaps. Offline only.

privacy.data_handling: Configuration exports are analysed in memory.
privacy.external_services: None. No cloud credentials are needed or accepted; nothing is queried.

discovery_all_categories.name: Container Configuration Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits Dockerfiles and docker-compose files for unpinned images, root users, secrets in layers, curl|sh, privileged containers, host namespaces, Docker-socket and host mounts, capabilities and exposed databases.

privacy.data_handling: Files are parsed in memory; images are not pulled or built.

discovery_all_categories.name: Git Repository Security Scanner
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks a Git repository for credentials in remote URLs, insecure remotes/submodules, sslVerify=false, plaintext credential helpers, active hooks, committed keys/.env/tfstate/dumps, .gitignore gaps and secrets in files.

privacy.data_handling: Repository files are read in memory; secret values are masked. git is never executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Infrastructure-as-Code Scanner
discovery_all_categories.description: Scans Terraform and CloudFormation templates for open security groups, public storage, missing encryption, public databases, IMDSv1 and over-privileged IAM, using the same rules as the cloud configuration tools.

privacy.data_handling: Templates are parsed in memory and never applied or evaluated.

discovery_all_categories.name: IAM Configuration Auditor
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits AWS IAM policies and trust policies (admin wildcards, privilege-escalation paths), the AWS credential report (root keys, missing MFA, old keys), Azure role definitions and GCP IAM bindings.

privacy.data_handling: Policies and the credential report (user names, dates; no secrets) are analysed in memory.
privacy.external_services: None. No credentials are needed; nothing is queried.

discovery_all_categories.name: Kubernetes Configuration Auditor
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks Kubernetes manifests against Pod Security Standards (privileged, host namespaces, hostPath, capabilities, root, seccomp) plus RBAC wildcards, anonymous bindings, inline secrets, resource limits and exposed services.

privacy.data_handling: Manifests are parsed in memory; no cluster is contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Public Storage Exposure Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks S3 bucket policies/ACLs/Block Public Access, Azure container access and GCS IAM for public exposure, and optionally confirms anonymous listing with one request to an authorized bucket URL.

privacy.data_handling: Policies and ACLs are analysed in memory.
privacy.external_services: Only with probe_url and authorization_confirmed: one anonymous HTTPS GET to that URL.

discovery_all_categories.name: Dependency Vulnerability Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Finds dependency versions affected by OSV advisories: offline against advisories you supply, or (opt-in) via the public OSV.dev API. Supports 12 manifest/lockfile formats across PyPI, npm, Go, RubyGems, Packagist, crates.io, Maven.

privacy.data_handling: Manifests are parsed in memory.
privacy.external_services: Only with online=true: package names, ecosystems and versions are sent to https://api.osv.dev.

discovery_all_categories.name: License Compliance Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Classifies dependency licenses (SPDX expressions, free-text names, LICENSE file texts) and flags conflicts with the chosen distribution model (proprietary, SaaS, internal, open source) plus allow/deny lists. Not legal advice.

privacy.data_handling: Package names and license strings are analysed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Lockfile Integrity Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits lockfiles and requirements for unpinned versions, missing/weak integrity hashes, HTTP or git sources, extra indexes (dependency confusion), trusted hosts and manifest/lockfile drift.

privacy.data_handling: Lockfiles are parsed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: SBOM Generator
discovery_all_categories.description: Generates a reproducible CycloneDX 1.5 JSON SBOM (components, purls, scopes, licenses, hashes) from manifests and lockfiles, and reports unresolved versions and missing hashes.

privacy.data_handling: Manifests are parsed in memory; the SBOM is returned, not stored.

discovery_all_categories.name: Secrets Scanner
discovery_all_categories.description: Scans a set of files or a local directory for committed secrets, de-duplicates them by fingerprint, downgrades test/docs matches and flags secret-bearing files (.env, keys, keystores). Values are never shown.

privacy.data_handling: Files are read in memory; secret values are fingerprinted and masked, never returned.

local_access: files under 'directory' (read-only; .git, node_modules, venvs and binaries skipped)

discovery_all_categories.name: Secure Configuration Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks Django, nginx, Apache, php.ini, .env and Spring Boot configuration for debug mode, wildcard hosts/CORS, insecure cookies, directory listing, version disclosure, legacy TLS, exposed actuators and hard-coded secrets.

privacy.data_handling: Configuration is analysed in memory; secret values are masked.

discovery_all_categories.name: Source Code Security Scanner
discovery_all_categories.description: Static analysis for injection sinks, disabled TLS verification, weak crypto, insecure randomness, debug mode, insecure temp files and permissions in Python (AST), JS/TS, PHP, Java, Go, C/C++, C# and Ruby.

privacy.data_handling: Source code is analysed in memory and never executed or stored.

discovery_all_categories.name: SQL Injection Pattern Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Detects SQL built by concatenation, f-strings, % or .format instead of bound parameters (Python AST; JS/TS, PHP, Java, C#, Go, Ruby patterns), with higher severity when request input is read nearby.

privacy.data_handling: Source code is analysed in memory and never executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Unsafe Deserialization Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Finds unsafe deserialization in Python, Java, .NET, PHP, Ruby and Node code, and inspects serialized blobs (pickle opcodes, Java/.NET/PHP formats) without loading them.

privacy.data_handling: Code and blobs are analysed in memory; blobs are never deserialized.

discovery_all_categories.name: XSS Pattern Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Detects cross-site-scripting patterns: DOM sinks, framework escape hatches, disabled template auto-escaping, javascript: URLs, PHP echo of request data and Flask render_template_string, with source-aware severity.

privacy.data_handling: Source code is analysed in memory and never executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Display Name Impersonation Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Compare a supplied From display name with an explicitly provided brand list and sender domain.

privacy.data_handling: Message header and brand strings are processed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: DKIM Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Validate required tags in supplied DKIM metadata; cryptographic message verification is not implemented.

privacy.data_handling: Supplied DKIM values are parsed in memory.
privacy.external_services: No DNS query; no canonicalized signature verification.

discovery_all_categories.name: DMARC Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Parse a supplied DMARC record and validate required policy and percentage fields.

privacy.data_handling: DMARC text is parsed in memory.
privacy.external_services: No DNS query or policy evaluation.

discovery_all_categories.name: Email Attachment Risk Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Assess attachment filenames and declared content types for executable and misleading extension risks.

privacy.data_handling: Attachment names and declared media types are analyzed in memory; files are not opened.

discovery_all_categories.name: Email Header Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Parse selected RFC email headers and compare visible From and Return-Path domains.

privacy.data_handling: Message headers are parsed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Email Phishing Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Reuse the frozen Sentinel local message and URL heuristics on supplied email text.

privacy.data_handling: Email text is analyzed locally in memory.
privacy.external_services: No network or reputation service is contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Email Spoofing Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Reuse the frozen local message analyzer to review supplied authentication and sender headers.

privacy.data_handling: Message is analyzed locally in memory.
privacy.external_services: No DNS or mailbox service is contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Email URL Extractor
discovery_all_categories.description: Extract URLs from supplied email text and apply local URL heuristics without opening the links.

privacy.data_handling: Email text and extracted URLs are analyzed locally.
privacy.external_services: No links are opened or contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Sender Identity Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Parse From and Reply-To identities and compare their supplied domains.

privacy.data_handling: Message headers are parsed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: SPF Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Check a supplied SPF record's prefix, all mechanism placement, and approximate DNS lookup count.

privacy.data_handling: SPF record text is parsed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: File content inspection
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspect an uploaded file in memory using CyberScan's existing bounded static analyzer.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are decoded in memory and are not written to disk by this adapter.

discovery_all_categories.name: Archive Security Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspect ZIP metadata, member names, declared sizes, and compression ratios without extraction.

privacy.data_handling: Archive bytes and metadata are handled in memory; members are not extracted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Digital Certificate Inspector
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspect a supplied X.509 certificate's identity, validity, key, and signature metadata.

privacy.data_handling: Certificate material is parsed in memory.
privacy.external_services: No revocation or trust service is queried.

discovery_all_categories.name: Digital Signature Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Verify a detached signature against a supplied public key; does not establish certificate trust.

privacy.data_handling: File, signature, and public-key bytes are processed in memory.
privacy.external_services: None; trust-chain validation is not performed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Embedded Payload Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Look for secondary file signatures and reuse existing bounded static content analysis.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are analyzed in memory; embedded files are not extracted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Entropy Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Measure Shannon byte entropy and flag unusually high entropy as a review heuristic.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are measured in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: File Hash Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Calculate cryptographic hashes for a bounded, user-supplied file.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are decoded and hashed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: File Type Mismatch Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Compare a file's extension with its detected byte signature.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are inspected in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Macro Security Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Find macro-related Office container entries and reuse bounded static document analysis.

privacy.data_handling: Document bytes are analyzed in memory; macros are never executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: PDF Active Content Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspect PDF bytes for common active-content tokens without opening or executing actions.

privacy.data_handling: PDF bytes are scanned in memory; actions and embedded files are not opened.

discovery_all_categories.name: PE Structure Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Parse portable-executable headers and sections without loading or executing the file.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are parsed in memory; no executable code is run.

discovery_all_categories.name: Executable Section Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Review PE section sizes, entropy, permissions, and entry point without loading the binary.

privacy.data_handling: PE bytes are parsed in memory; no executable code runs.

discovery_all_categories.name: Malware Indicator Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Reuse the frozen bounded Sentinel static analyzer and report its indicators.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are passed to the frozen local scanner in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Malware Similarity Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Compare two files by exact hash and sampled byte shingles without claiming family attribution.

privacy.data_handling: Both file byte arrays are decoded in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Packer Indicator Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspect PE section names and entropy for possible packing indicators.

privacy.data_handling: PE bytes are parsed in memory; no binary is executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Persistence Indicator Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Search supplied text for common Windows, Linux, and macOS persistence paths and commands.

privacy.data_handling: Text is searched in memory and is not executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Ransomware Indicator Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Flag common ransomware-related commands and phrases in supplied text without running them.

privacy.data_handling: Text is searched in memory and is not executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Script Obfuscation Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Flag common encoding and dynamic-evaluation patterns in user-supplied script text.

privacy.data_handling: Script text is matched in memory and never executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Shellcode Pattern Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Match a small set of common shellcode byte patterns in supplied bytes; no payload is executed.

privacy.data_handling: Bytes are matched in memory; no payload is decoded or executed.

discovery_all_categories.name: Suspicious API Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Find selected sensitive API names in printable file strings without executing the file.

privacy.data_handling: File bytes are searched in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: YARA Rule Scanner
discovery_all_categories.description: Compile and run bounded user-supplied YARA rules against in-memory file bytes when yara-python is installed.

privacy.data_handling: Rules and file bytes are processed locally in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Certificate Chain Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Validates a TLS certificate chain (PEM or from one handshake): trust path, signatures, dates, host name, key sizes, SHA-1/MD5 signatures and CA constraints.

privacy.data_handling: Certificates are public data and are parsed in memory.
privacy.external_services: Only when 'host' is given: one TLS handshake to that host and port.

external_services: The TLS server named in 'host' (live mode only)

discovery_all_categories.name: DNS Security Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits SPF, DMARC, DKIM (named selectors), MX, NS redundancy, CAA and DNSSEC presence for one domain, from supplied records or passive DNS lookups. It does not probe mail servers or enumerate subdomains.

privacy.data_handling: Only the domain name and its public DNS records are processed, in memory.
privacy.external_services: With resolve=true, DNS queries for the domain's own records go to the system or given resolver.

discovery_all_categories.name: DNSSEC Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Validates DNSKEY self-signatures, RRSIGs on supplied RRsets and the DS-to-DNSKEY match for one zone, and flags weak algorithms or expiring signatures. Offline (zone text) or passive live queries.

privacy.data_handling: Only public DNS data for the zone is processed, in memory.
privacy.external_services: With resolve=true, DNSKEY/DS/SOA queries for the zone go to the system or given resolver.

discovery_all_categories.name: HSTS Configuration Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks the Strict-Transport-Security header (syntax, max-age, includeSubDomains, preload readiness, duplicates, delivery over HTTP) from pasted headers or one passive request to a named URL.

privacy.data_handling: Response headers are parsed in memory; response bodies are not kept.
privacy.external_services: Only with 'url': one HTTPS request (and one HTTP request if check_http_redirect).

external_services: The web server named in 'url' (live mode only)

discovery_all_categories.name: Public IP Reputation Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Classifies IP addresses (private, reserved, bogon, documentation, CGNAT, multicast) and matches them against user-supplied CIDR blocklists and allowlists. No built-in or online reputation feed is used.

privacy.data_handling: Addresses and lists are matched in memory; nothing is sent anywhere.
privacy.external_services: None. Online reputation services are deliberately not queried.

discovery_all_categories.name: MTA-STS Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Validates the MTA-STS TXT record and policy (version, mode, mx patterns, max_age), checks that MX hosts match the policy and that TLS-RPT reporting is configured. Offline or passive DNS/HTTPS lookups.

privacy.data_handling: Public DNS records and the public policy file are processed in memory.
privacy.external_services: Live mode: DNS queries for the domain, and one HTTPS GET of its policy file if fetch_policy.

discovery_all_categories.name: Network Anomaly Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Finds scans, sweeps, beaconing, DNS tunnelling and unusual outbound volume in exported flow records (JSON, CSV or Zeek conn.log). Behavioural heuristics, not confirmed compromise.

privacy.data_handling: Flow records (addresses, ports, byte counts) are analysed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Network Configuration Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits sshd_config and Cisco IOS-style device configurations for weak authentication, cleartext management, default SNMP communities, weak ciphers and missing hardening. Text analysis only; nothing is contacted.

privacy.data_handling: The configuration text is analysed in memory; secrets in it are masked in the output.

discovery_all_categories.name: Authorized Service Exposure Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Flags risky listening services from a netstat/ss listing, or TCP-connect-checks a small set of ports on hosts you are authorized to test. Connect only: no payloads, banner grabbing, brute force or exploitation.

privacy.data_handling: Socket listings are parsed in memory. Probe mode only opens and closes TCP connections.
privacy.external_services: Probe mode connects to the hosts you list; listing mode contacts nothing.

discovery_all_categories.name: Network Traffic Metadata Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Reads pcap/pcapng captures (headers and DNS question names only), builds flows and flags cleartext protocols, port scans, periodic beaconing, DNS tunnelling patterns and unusual outbound volume.

privacy.data_handling: The capture is parsed in memory; only header fields and DNS names are used, payloads are discarded.

discovery_all_categories.name: API Key Exposure Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Detects exposed API keys and tokens for 30+ providers in text and reports masked previews, fingerprints and lines. Keys are never validated against providers.

privacy.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; key values are masked and fingerprinted, never returned or stored.
privacy.external_services: None: keys are never sent to providers for validation.

discovery_all_categories.name: Browser Privacy Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits Chromium Preferences/Local State and Firefox prefs.js for disabled Safe Browsing, third-party cookies, disabled tracking protection, password-leak detection, DNS-over-HTTPS and site permissions granted by default.

privacy.data_handling: Only setting values are read; history, cookies and saved passwords are never opened.

discovery_all_categories.name: Cookie Tracking Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Identifies tracking cookies (bundled vendor list), third-party and long-lived cookies, and missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite protection on session cookies, from Set-Cookie headers, HAR files or cookies.txt.

privacy.data_handling: Cookie names and attributes are analysed in memory; cookie values are never returned.

discovery_all_categories.name: Credential Exposure Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Detects exposed passwords and private keys: PEM/SSH keys, service-account keys, credentials in connection strings and URLs, Basic auth, .netrc, htpasswd, unattend.xml and hard-coded password assignments.

privacy.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; credentials are masked and fingerprinted, never returned or stored.

discovery_all_categories.name: Data Leakage Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Pre-sharing check for text, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX and PDF: secrets, personal data, internal host names and paths, author/company metadata, comments, tracked changes, hidden text, embedded objects and old PDF revisions.

privacy.data_handling: Content is analysed in memory; secrets and personal data are masked in the result.

discovery_all_categories.name: EXIF Metadata Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Lists privacy-relevant image metadata: GPS location, device serial numbers, owner names, timestamps, software, embedded thumbnails and XMP/IPTC/comment blocks (JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF).

privacy.data_handling: The image is parsed in memory and never stored. GPS coordinates in the result are rounded to about 1 km.

dependencies: Pillow (EXIF value decoding; structure-only without it)

discovery_all_categories.name: Log Privacy Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Scans log files for credentials, tokens, session cookies, secrets in query strings, logged passwords, personal data and stack traces, and suggests masking patterns. Values are masked in the output.

privacy.data_handling: Log lines are scanned in memory; only categories, counts, line numbers and masked samples are returned.

discovery_all_categories.name: Metadata Removal Validator
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks that metadata was actually stripped from an image, Office document or PDF, and (given the original) lists what was removed and what remains. Pass/fail per check.

privacy.data_handling: Both files are parsed in memory; metadata values are summarised, not stored.

discovery_all_categories.name: PII Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Detects personal data (emails, cards, IBANs, SSNs, Saudi IDs, UK NINOs, phones, IPs, birth dates, passports) with checksum validation where one exists, and reports masked samples, counts and line numbers.

privacy.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; detected values are masked in the result and never stored.

discovery_all_categories.name: Sensitive Data Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Assigns a sensitivity level to text from classification markings (English and Arabic) and sensitive content categories: health, financial, HR, legal privilege, credentials and personal data.

privacy.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; only categories, counts and line numbers are reported.

discovery_all_categories.name: Browser Extension Risk Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Rates browser extensions (manifest, .crx/.zip/.xpi package or local browser profiles) for powerful permissions, all-site session access, weakened CSP, off-store updates, Manifest V2 and broad injection.

privacy.data_handling: Manifests and packages are read in memory. Local mode reads only extension manifest files in browser profiles.

discovery_all_categories.name: Firewall Configuration Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks Windows Firewall profiles and rules (netsh), iptables-save and ufw for disabled profiles, allow-by-default inbound policy and rules exposing remote-admin or file-sharing ports to any address.

privacy.data_handling: Firewall configuration text is analysed in memory.

local_access: netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name=all (read-only)

discovery_all_categories.name: Installed Software Risk Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Flags installed software past end of support (bundled, dated lifecycle table), remote-access tools, installs in user-writable folders and unknown publishers. No CVE lookup is performed.

privacy.data_handling: The software inventory is analysed in memory. Local mode reads the Windows Uninstall registry keys only.

discovery_all_categories.name: Local Permission Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Flags world-writable files and folders, setuid/setgid binaries, private keys readable by others and Windows ACLs that let broad groups modify files, from ls -l/icacls output or a read-only walk of listed paths.

privacy.data_handling: Only file names and permission metadata are read; file contents are never opened.

local_access: metadata (stat) of the listed paths and their children, up to max_depth

discovery_all_categories.name: Persistence Configuration Auditor
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits Windows persistence registry points (Winlogon, IFEO, AppInit, LSA packages, services, COM hijacks...) and Linux persistence files (systemd, rc, shell profiles, authorized_keys, ld.so.preload, udev).

privacy.data_handling: Registry exports and files are analysed in memory; command-line secrets are masked.

discovery_all_categories.name: Process Security Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Analyses a process snapshot for user-writable executables, masquerading names, suspicious parent-child chains (Office -> shell), encoded/LOLBin command lines and duplicated singleton system processes.

privacy.data_handling: The process list is analysed in memory; command lines are masked in the output.

local_access: process list: name, path, command line, parent, user (read)

discovery_all_categories.name: Scheduled Task Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Reviews Windows scheduled-task XML and cron tables for tasks launching from temporary folders, encoded or LOLBin commands, download-and-run cron jobs and hidden privileged tasks triggered at boot or logon.

privacy.data_handling: Task definitions are parsed in memory; command-line secrets are masked.

discovery_all_categories.name: Startup Entry Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspects Run/RunOnce and Startup-folder autostart entries (list, .reg export or local read-only) for user-writable paths, masquerading, encoded PowerShell, LOLBin abuse and unquoted paths.

privacy.data_handling: Autostart entries are analysed in memory; command-line secrets are masked in the output.

discovery_all_categories.name: System Configuration Auditor
discovery_all_categories.description: Audits Windows registry security settings (.reg export or local read-only) and Linux kernel sysctl values against common hardening baselines: UAC, credential protection, legacy protocols, RDP, AutoRun, ASLR and more.

privacy.data_handling: Configuration values are analysed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: System Update Status Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Checks OS release support (dated lifecycle tables for Windows builds and major Linux distributions), age of the newest installed Windows hotfix, and pending apt security updates.

privacy.data_handling: OS version and update lists are analysed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: DNS Record Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Summarize user-supplied DNS records; performs no DNS query.

privacy.data_handling: Provided DNS record strings are analyzed locally.

discovery_all_categories.name: Domain Expiration Checker
discovery_all_categories.description: Evaluate a user-supplied domain expiration timestamp without querying a registrar or WHOIS service.

privacy.data_handling: Supplied timestamp is evaluated locally.
privacy.external_services: No registrar, WHOIS, or RDAP service is contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Domain Reputation Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Apply local structural URL heuristics to a domain; no live reputation data is available.

privacy.data_handling: Domain is analyzed locally.
privacy.external_services: No DNS, WHOIS, or reputation service is contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Homograph Attack Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspect internationalized hostname forms and local brand-impersonation heuristics.

privacy.data_handling: URL is analyzed locally.

discovery_all_categories.name: Phishing URL Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Use Sentinel's offline URL heuristics to identify phishing-style URL indicators.

privacy.data_handling: URL is analyzed locally.
privacy.external_services: No network or reputation service is contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: Redirect Chain Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Analyze a user-supplied sequence of observed redirect URLs without following network redirects.

privacy.data_handling: Supplied URLs are analyzed locally.
privacy.external_services: No HTTP requests or redirect following.

discovery_all_categories.name: SSL Certificate Inspector
discovery_all_categories.description: Inspect an explicitly supplied X.509 certificate; does not establish a live TLS connection.

privacy.data_handling: Certificate material is parsed in memory.
privacy.external_services: No live TLS, revocation, or trust query.

discovery_all_categories.name: Suspicious Subdomain Detector
discovery_all_categories.description: Flag lure-like subdomain labels in a supplied hostname without resolving it.

privacy.data_handling: Hostname is parsed locally.
privacy.external_services: No DNS or reputation service is queried.

discovery_all_categories.name: URL Reputation Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Apply local URL heuristics; no external reputation source is queried or implied.

privacy.data_handling: URL is analyzed locally.
privacy.external_services: No reputation service or network is contacted.

discovery_all_categories.name: URL Shortener Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Identify selected known shortener domains without resolving or following the link.

privacy.data_handling: URL hostname is parsed locally.

discovery_all_categories.name: Content Security Policy Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Parse a supplied CSP header and flag common broad or unsafe source expressions.

privacy.data_handling: CSP text is parsed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: Cookie Security Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Review supplied Set-Cookie lines for Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes.

privacy.data_handling: Cookie strings are parsed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: CORS Configuration Analyzer
discovery_all_categories.description: Assess user-supplied Access-Control response headers for risky wildcard and credential combinations.

privacy.data_handling: Supplied headers are analyzed in memory.

discovery_all_categories.name: HTTP Security Headers Analyzer
